name: KAGURA-HD PCM streaming SPI (Queue8, SPI overlay)
configuration: optional SPI configuration; build-time exclusive with releases/pcm-stream-qspi (no runtime switching, no dual-protocol bitstream)
supersedes: artifacts/experimental/spi-sta-fail (PCM2 SPI, STA fail, never validated)
qspi_release_unchanged: releases/pcm-stream-qspi and artifacts/validated/kagura-hd-qspi-pcm-stream.fs (fad15376...) are not modified; a QSPI build of this tree reproduces the selected stage-1 netlist body 79434504...
netlist_note: Not shipped (about 2.6 MB); reproduce.ps1 regenerates it and checks the body hash (lines starting with // excluded)
abi: 1.4 (KFB1, CAPS FF) + PCM stream extension, same as the QSPI release
transport: SPI mode 0, MSB first, MOSI=IO0, MISO=IO1 (IO2/IO3 unused, never driven by the FPGA)
rtl: releases/pcm-stream-qspi build-inputs (41 files, unchanged) + rtl/spi overlay (kagura_spi_adapter, kagura_fb_scanout, kagura_fb_commands, kagura_fb_cursor) + tools/build-fb.tcl with the spi-only overlay substitution
flow: tools/build-fb.tcl spi 4 2 8 0 1 auto (synthesis + P&R place 4 / route 2; the build log lists four KAGURA_SPI_OVERLAY substitutions)

spi_clock.optional_fast_note: tested-fast configuration on one board; not a guaranteed operating frequency
spi_clock.host_setting: CMake -DKAGURA_HOST_LANES=1 [-DKAGURA_SPI_PIO_DIV=1.25 for 8 MHz]; SCK = 120 MHz / (12 * div)

uf2.uf2_elf_check: validation/uf2-elf-check.json: every ELF load byte present in the UF2, 0 mismatches
uf2.qspi_uf2_unchanged: QSPI release builds of this tree reproduce four-operators.uf2 6c8a2fd9... and midnight-terminal.uf2 aa37c59d...

validation.simulation: PASS, tools/test-fb-spi.sh 11 checks (validation/spi-regression.log): frozen-vs-overlay scanout equivalence (3 seeds), cursor reference (mailbox 0/1), /CS glitch filtered and unfiltered, tb_fb_host and PCM2 board LANES=1 Queue8
validation.reproduction: PASS: netlist body, .bin and .fs (except Created Time) identical; STA 0/0 (validation/reproduce-result.json)
validation.hardware_5mhz: PASS: FOUR OPERATORS, MIDNIGHT TERMINAL, BEYOND 16 COLORS (all 8 scenes) ran to completion; timeouts 0, audio faults 0, HDMI audio 10 ms low-RMS 0/0; both release UF2s auto-started and completed
validation.hardware_clock_sweep: 5/6/8 MHz PASS (8 MHz: all three demos and the bench with PSRAM compare); 10 MHz FAIL at device identification (validation/clock-sweep.json)
validation.restore: every run restored the RP2040 Flash (verified byte-for-byte) and the approved Queue8 FPGA SRAM image; no FPGA Flash writes

limits: Finite runs on one board and one HDMI capture path; no PVT, long-term or multi-board coverage
Setup margin 0.159 ns; the same netlist fails at place 3 (-3.427 ns) and place 2 (-4.370 ns), so any change to the inputs or P&R options needs STA and hardware checks again
SPI bandwidth is a quarter of QSPI at the same SCK: demo frame counts are 3-14% lower than QSPI at 5 MHz and 1-5% lower at 8 MHz; audio is unaffected
8 MHz is an optional tested-fast setting, not a guaranteed frequency; 10 MHz and above are unsupported
6 and 8 MHz use fractional PIO dividers (SCK period jitter of one PIO clock)
External SPI pad timing is not in STA (host signals are false paths through the 2FF oversampling synchronizers)
The MicroPython SPI helper (SoftSPI 1 MHz) was not re-run on this image
publication_blockers: Applicable Gowin redistribution terms unverified (same as the QSPI release)
